title: build(deps-dev): bump @types/node from 26.6.5 to 26.6.6 in /packages/client
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. Types-only devDependency bump inside the existing ^26 range. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid; that friction is the point.
behavior_change: None at runtime. DevDependency typings only. Lockfile enumerated by parsing both package-lock.json trees to JSON and comparing every entry under `packages` against merge base eafbad16 (400 entries before and after, 0 added, 0 removed): exactly one version moves -- node_modules/@types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6 (dev). undici-types does not move (~8.9.0 both sides). Dependabot's regeneration again flipped the `peer` flag on the same 16 unchanged-version entries seen on #432/#433/#447 (npm-version churn); reverted here per main's convention since ec88eedd, so the lockfile diff is the bump and nothing else.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares @types/node ^26.6.6 (was ^26.6.5). packages/client/package-lock.json resolves @types/node 26.6.6 (root devDependencies range + the one package entry: version, resolved, integrity). No other lockfile line differs from the merge base.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. The bump is open as PR #468 and both CBSP21 gates fail there for want of a manifest of its own; this is that manifest.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No production dependency. No source file. No build, lint or test configuration. Node engines range unchanged. Lockfile `peer` flags stay as on main (Dependabot's churn reverted).

commands_run: git merge-base origin/main b6656a63 -> eafbad16e47549e13cd4517c3dd3165203eb9cd4 (== origin/main)
lockfile JSON enumeration base eafbad16 vs Dependabot head b6656a63 -> 400->400, 0 added, 0 removed, 1 version change (@types/node 26.6.5->26.6.6), 16 peer-flag-only entries
python _bump_audit.py <worktree> @types/node -> advisories @types/node@26.6.5: 0, @types/node@26.6.6: 0; git merge-tree onto origin/main clean, 0 sibling reversions
npm view @types/node@26.6.6 dist.integrity == lockfile integrity; publisher `types`; scripts {} (no install hooks)

lockfile rebuilt as merge-base lockfile + the @types/node root range and package entry; serializer round-trips the base byte-for-byte; git diff eafbad16 -- packages/client shows only the 3 @types/node changes
npm ci --ignore-scripts on the rebuilt lockfile -> node_modules/@types/node version 26.6.6
npm run type-check under 26.6.6 -> 87 errors; check_client_type_check_ratchet.py PASS (ceiling 87)
npm i --no-save @types/node@26.6.5 && npm run type-check -> 87 errors; sorted `error TS` lines IDENTICAL to the 26.6.6 run
manual_verifications: Lockfile was enumerated by parsing both JSON trees, NOT by reading the diff view (PR #296 precedent).
Type-check A/B old vs new version on the same tree gives an identical error set, so the typings change surfaces no new or removed errors in client src.
No `--omit=peer` in CI or Dockerfiles, so the reverted peer churn had no install effect; reverted for diff hygiene and to avoid sibling-bump lockfile conflicts.
